post.title: EXAMPLE: My Paper Summary
post.description: This paper introduces mBLIP, a lightweight multilingual extension of BLIP-2. Instead of retraining a full vision-language model, the authors reuse the original BLIP-2 image encoder and align it to a multilingual language model using small amounts of translated captioning and VQA data.
